recipes.name: Raster plan + site photographs + controls + library → IFC and registered context
recipes.goal: Semantic building with sourced components, registered observed surfaces and visual scene
handoffs: Plan scale and heights are explicit inputs to semantic building creation.
OCR labels are reconciled with plan features before wall/opening creation.
Control correspondences align the observed cloud with IFC placements; independent controls evaluate the alignment.
Library components retain source identity and instance transforms.

artifact_roles.drawing: original raster plan and extracted topology
artifact_roles.controls: shared frame/scale and separate assessment controls
artifact_roles.authority: IFC building plus retained source evidence

recipes.summary: Combine plan interpretation with measured site surfaces and identified library components; preserve the IFC model, photo solution and conversion map.

recipes.name: Vector profile + dimensions + library parts → articulated CAD, MJCF and URDF
recipes.goal: Editable part/assembly with separate visual/collision derivatives and source-linked robot descriptions
handoffs: The brief defines rigid links and joint intent; geometry alone supplies no motion definition.
Interface frames bind component placement to named datums.
Mass properties are assigned per rigid body from recorded data or stated density/volume calculations.
URDF and MJCF are separate named derivatives of the same assembly revision.

artifact_roles.dynamics: per-body mass, centre of mass and inertia with sources

recipes.summary: Use a dimensioned part as one assembly component, place identified library parts, author explicit joints and physical data, and derive robot packages.

recipes.name: Photographs + measured controls + component library → CAD assembly and MuJoCo model
recipes.goal: Measured-reference CAD assembly with explicit robot structure and collision derivatives
handoffs: Calibration/control images and reconstruction images retain distinct roles.
Fit controls and independent measurement controls are identified separately.
A library match is an identified component decision supported by interfaces and provenance.
Hidden surfaces retain inference labels through CAD and simulation export.

artifact_roles.checks: source dimensions, regional deviations and body/joint transforms

recipes.summary: Reconstruct visible surfaces, fit candidate features, remodel selected parts, combine them with identified hardware and author the robot model.

recipes.name: Existing housing CAD + depth scan + drawing → revised interface and reusable component
recipes.goal: Revisioned replacement component fitted to the retained housing and registered scan
handoffs: Source housing and replacement CAD have separate artifact IDs.
Depth calibration, shared datums and transforms connect the cloud to the housing.
Drawing constraints and fit residuals remain attributable to their respective sources.
Catalogue registration pins the revised component assets and their source licences.

artifact_roles.revision: replacement interface CAD and updated component metadata

recipes.summary: Use the housing as a stable reference, drawing dimensions as constraints and scan surfaces as local evidence for the scoped replacement.

recipes.name: Robot CAD + Menagerie MJCF + depth environment → combined simulation scene
recipes.goal: MuJoCo scene with explicit CAD-link mapping and scanned-environment collision geometry
handoffs: The supplied MJCF is a named model revision with its own licence record.
CAD-to-body mapping checks transforms and joints before modifying a derivative.
Environment mesh and colliders have separate assets and aligned frames.
Source robot dynamics retain their recorded source/model-fidelity status.
recipes.summary: Reuse a specifically licensed simulation package, map CAD occurrences to its bodies and add a registered scanned environment.

recipes.name: IFC building + existing robot MJCF → building collision environment and semantic display
recipes.goal: Robot scene with building colliders and a retained IFC/GLB identity map
handoffs: Select the building surfaces used as simulation environment.
Preserve IFC-to-mesh element mapping and unit/frame conversion.
Inspect doorway/contact channels after convex decomposition.
The supplied MJCF and the environment-augmented derivative have distinct revision IDs.
recipes.summary: Derive colliders from selected building elements while preserving semantic IFC as the building source.

recipes.name: Sketch over registered 3D + dimensions → revised CAD and fabrication package
recipes.goal: Source-linked native CAD revision, comparison record and fabrication derivatives
handoffs: Store stroke pixels, camera pose/intrinsics and hit component/triangle IDs.
Ray hits are calculated anchors; their evidence follows the hit surface and camera calibration.
Sketch-plane, feature meaning and governing dimensions are explicit before CAD construction.
Fabrication output uses the checked CAD revision and stated material/process information.

artifact_roles.output: native model revision and its requested fabrication derivatives

recipes.summary: Anchor screen annotations to the selected surface, interpret feature intent and construct a dimensioned CAD revision.

recipes.name: Orthographic rasters + dimensions → candidate geometry and component record
recipes.goal: Multi-view reconstruction hypothesis with checked projections and provenance
handoffs: The raster-sketch input contains distinct front/top/side views with recorded projection convention.
Dimension and correspondence alternatives remain attributed to source views.
Reproject the candidate into every supplied view and compare independent dimensions.
The library record retains candidate/inferred status for hidden geometry.

artifact_roles.catalogue: revisioned component record with inference labels

recipes.summary: Use multiple orthographic views and dimension evidence to propose a consistent 3D model and record the result as a source-linked candidate component.

recipes.name: One photo capture → Gaussian context + independent MVS mesh + CAD
recipes.goal: Aligned visual scene, independently reconstructed measured surface and remodeled CAD
handoffs: Both branches preserve the same camera/image lineage.
Gaussian output remains a visual scene representation.
Dense MVS and measured controls supply the surface evidence used for remodeling.
Regional deviations and source dimensions evaluate the CAD derivative.

artifact_roles.alignment: camera solution, scale and control transform

recipes.summary: Fork the capture into a view-synthesis branch and dense geometry branch, then retain their alignment with the CAD interpretation.

recipes.name: IFC + reusable library components → exact geometry branch and static MuJoCo environment
recipes.goal: Semantic building revision with geometry derivatives and reusable source metadata
handoffs: Geometry extraction keeps the source IFC graph and object identity mapping.
B-rep extraction and tessellation are separately recorded representation changes.
Static environment MJCF uses colliders derived from the selected mesh and stated frame.
Component versioning records the native source and intended derivative roles.
recipes.summary: Place identified library elements into IFC, retain an explicit B-rep extraction branch and derive a static simulation environment.

ideas.name: Shared frame and anchor record
ideas.summary: Use one versioned record to relate pixels, camera rays, scan coordinates, CAD datums and component IDs.
ideas.next_check: Compare transform direction, units and anchor round trips in the selected tools.

ideas.name: Source-to-feature association
ideas.summary: Retain each fitted or interpreted surface region and the exact CAD feature it supports.
ideas.next_check: Compare fitted-plane/cylinder evidence with saved feature and dimension readback.

ideas.name: Importer/exporter field mapping
ideas.summary: Maintain actual preserved/transformed/discarded field mappings per tool/version.
ideas.next_check: Run the same component and assembly fixtures through the intended consumers.

ideas.name: Ambiguous-view comparison
ideas.summary: Retain several geometrically consistent interpretations until source evidence distinguishes them.
ideas.next_check: Compare projected views and independent dimensions, with inference labels by feature.

ideas.name: Dependency-driven revision updates
ideas.summary: Record which branch depends on each measurement, component revision and interpretation.
ideas.next_check: Trace a single input change through affected recipes and derivative revisions.

ideas.name: Text-to-concept-image-to-mesh route
ideas.summary: Register a possible branch from text or sketch through a concept image to an image-conditioned mesh, then measured CAD remodeling.
ideas.next_check: Research an open image-generation backend and its exact weight/output terms before defining the first transition.

ideas.name: Procedural field geometry supplement
ideas.summary: Evaluate PicoGK/ShapeKernel as a separate source-driven geometry branch with explicit field/mesh resolution and OCS interchange checks.
ideas.next_check: Use the existing archived sources to define runtime/platform, output representation and comparison experiments.

ideas.name: Targeted first-pilot handoff review
ideas.summary: Resolve exact tools, representations, editable sources, unit/frame mappings and prerequisites for four route cards before the pilot experiments.
ideas.next_check: Produce four route cards and a bounded source-linked experiment list.

ideas.name: Shared records and fixture briefs
ideas.summary: Define model/evidence/artifact/component/check records and three dimensioned fixture briefs.
ideas.next_check: Check representation, identity and evidence fields against the selected routes.

ideas.name: OCS baseline pilot
ideas.summary: Exercise the existing OCS skill on a bracket and mating plate, including a revision, native save/reopen and measured derivative checks.
ideas.next_check: Record the actual installed capabilities and saved geometry for that fixture.

ideas.name: Text and drawing CAD pilot
ideas.summary: Compare text, raster sketch and DXF/SVG routes using the same dimensioned fixture and a complementary procedural-solid backend.
ideas.next_check: Compare dimensions, topology, editable source and importer readback.

ideas.name: Reconstruction and mixed-input pilot
ideas.summary: Combine photographs, controls, drawings or identified components into registered references and source-linked CAD remodeling, including anchored annotations.
ideas.next_check: Compare held-out measurements and regional scan-to-CAD deviations.

ideas.name: Architecture robotics and component pilot
ideas.summary: Exercise IFC building semantics, robot joint/physical-property handoffs and a pilot reusable component library.
ideas.next_check: Check loaded domain models, frames, geometry roles and source identities.

ideas.name: Package exercised skills and helpers
ideas.summary: Package exercised workflows with skills, scripts, examples, dependency records and shared CLI operations.
ideas.next_check: Run the relevant fixture and preserve actual execution evidence for each supported route.
